MU.name: Musa
MU.look: a strong kind man in his thirties with a short black beard, a cream turban and an indigo robe, holding a tall wooden staff

MY.name: young Musa
MY.look: a strong kind young man with short black hair and no beard, in a white tunic with a blue sash

HA.name: Harun
HA.look: a gentle man with a short black beard, a white turban and a green robe

PH.name: Pharaoh
PH.look: a proud stern king with a short black beard, an ancient Nile-valley king's tall blue-and-gold striped headdress (not a European crown, no fur) and a red-and-gold robe

ASIYA.name: Queen Asiya
ASIYA.look: a kind queen in a teal silk headscarf with a thin gold circlet and a white-and-gold gown

MUM.name: Musa's mother
MUM.look: a gentle young mother in a rust-orange headscarf and a cream dress

SIS.name: Musa's sister
SIS.look: a clever girl of ten in a yellow headscarf draped over her head and shoulders that fully covers her hair, and a long-sleeved green dress

ELD.name: the old father
ELD.look: a very old man with a long white beard, a white turban and a brown cloak

DAU.name: the two daughters
DAU.look: two modest young women in long dresses and headscarves, one in purple and one in sky blue

KH.name: al-Khidr
KH.look: a wise old man with a white beard, in a green turban and a long green cloak

YU.name: Yusha
YU.look: a helpful boy of twelve in a short brown tunic and a small white cap

SAM.name: the Samiri
SAM.look: a sly thin man in a grey robe and a dark red turban
